# URAWAKE Stackhouse

## What is URAWAKE Stackhouse?
URAWAKE Stackhouse is a web development studio founded by Daniel Sangronis, based in Los Angeles, California. We design and build full-stack web applications, CRMs, and digital tools for small businesses and startups across the United States.

## What does URAWAKE Stackhouse build?
Full-stack web applications, booking systems, internal CRM platforms, marketing websites, and API integrations. We come in at the brand level — identity, design, and development — and deliver a complete, live product.

## Who is the right client for URAWAKE?
Small businesses and startups that need more than a template. Our main clientele is in tourism and hospitality, but we work across industries. We're the right fit if you need a partner who can think at the brand level and actually build it.

## Where does URAWAKE Stackhouse operate?
We serve clients across the United States. Most current clients are based in Puerto Rico and California.

## What does a typical project involve?
Every project starts with brand and product strategy, then moves into design and development. We build everything to production — no handoffs, no half-finished work.

## Who is Daniel Sangronis?
Daniel Sangronis is a web developer and creative director based in Los Angeles, California. He started building in late 2025 and has delivered full digital presences for multiple businesses in the tourism and hospitality space. GitHub: https://github.com/danielsangronis1386 | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-sangronis-65210117a/

## Services
- Full-stack development (React, Node.js, Django, PostgreSQL)
- API integration (Stripe, Gmail API, REST, Webhooks)
- CRM and internal business tools (leads, bookings, campaigns, automation)
- UI/UX build (Figma to code, responsive, motion-enhanced)
- Deployment and CI/CD (Vercel, Heroku, Netlify)

## Projects

### Eliot's Adventures
Full website and custom CRM for a family-run Puerto Rico tour and taxi service. Features tour listings, travel guides, and online booking. Live at: https://www.eliotsadventures.com/
Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Stripe, Gmail API, Heroku

### ToursToDo PR
Public-facing marketing website for ToursToDo Puerto Rico. Includes tour catalog with filters, island guide content, FAQ section, and Stripe-powered booking flow.
Stack: React, Vite, React Router v7, CSS Modules, Stripe, Vercel

### ToursToDo CRM
Internal operations platform for the ToursToDo team. Manages leads, bookings, customer segments, email campaigns, and affiliate tracking with AI-powered lead qualification.
Stack: React, Vite, Recharts, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Stripe, SendGrid, Heroku

### ClientFlow
Lightweight CRM and project tracker for freelancers. Manage clients, track project status, log billable hours, and generate invoices.
Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma

### Fitness Tracker
Mobile-first fitness app for tracking daily workouts, sets, reps, and personal records. Includes progress charts and a custom exercise library.
Stack: React, Vite, Recharts, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL

### RollingLog
Travel journaling platform where users document trips with geotagged entries, photos, and route maps.
Stack: React, Vite, Mapbox GL, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Cloudinary

## Tech Stack
JavaScript, React, Vite, Python, Django, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, REST APIs, Stripe, SendGrid, Gmail API, Mapbox GL, Recharts, HTML, CSS, Git, Vercel, Heroku, Netlify
